title: Lint workspaces apart for every requested target
goal: When gates select a nested Cargo workspace, run cross Clippy on its manifest for every supplied --target with --all-targets, --offline, --locked, -D warnings and SUSI_CROSS_CHECK=1. Keep the existing host checks. Run cross-target checks with the required second phase and propagate failures. Cover multiple targets and the no-target case. Record the warm first phase against the 10-second line and report the cross phase separately.
